description: Assets that have crossed onto X1 through a bridge (WSOL.X, USDC.X), read live from the chain. Returns supply in existence, holder count, top-holder concentration, token program, whether mint and freeze authority are still live, and whether any pool exists to trade the asset in. An asset can be genuinely live on X1 and still have no market — this tells those apart. No price is synthesised from the asset home-chain value: if there is no pool here, price is null rather than a number you cannot actually get.
name: bridge_assets
